# wikijs_api (Data Source)

The `wikijs_api` Data Source implements the Wiki.JS API query `authentication{apiState{…}}`.
It can be used to check if the API endpoint is enabled.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wikijs_api" "api" {
	enabled = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) States whether the Wiki.js API is enabled.
